decisions.reason: As a product line with its own page and a direct extension of the established format portfolio, its continuation cost is low and uncertainty remains high, so the option stays open.
The building digital twin service builds on the established offer and targets an emerging market, so the firm keeps the option while demand signals are still uncertain.
Although close to existing services, authentication and identity delegation is still an unresolved option with low marginal cost, so it is retained for now.
This open framework product line is central to the firm's component strategy and has low continuation costs, so the option is retained.
